NFL realized-action QB scramble/sack labels need not encode the same commitment distinction. All actual clean native committed scrambles remain included; negative gains are not silently converted to sacks or dropped.

The exact-QB NFL situational reference is observational and not an apples-to-apples physical calibration or proof that forces are wrong. Negative escape gains nominate QB escape decisions and classification audit first.
